evidence.summary: Changing discrepancy_ratio from 1.00 to 0.90 increased the score from 0.6534 to 0.9610. Further tests gave 0.9605 at 0.95 and 0.9763 at 0.99, while returning to 1.00 reduced the score.
Changing recent_seizures from 5 to 4 increased the score from 0.9686 to 0.9691, supporting 4 as better than 5 in the tested configuration.
In a clean comparison with the other tested inputs held fixed, shipper_score 600 produced 0.7495 while 900 produced 0.8680.
Scores improved from 0.9610 at 40 years to 0.9651 at 35 and 0.9686 at 30, then decreased to 0.9500 at 25, indicating a non-monotonic effect.
Changing route_age_days from 18 to 27 increased the score from 0.9691 to the best observed score of 0.9763, an improvement of 0.0072.
Testing ports A, B, C and D under the high-scoring configuration showed substantial differences. Port D gave the best observed result, while Port C produced a much lower score of 0.0430.
